step1_analysis.description: A wideband LNA utilizing a common-emitter input stage, an emitter follower, and a common-emitter output stage. It employs shunt-shunt feedback for broadband impedance matching and flat gain.

paper_reference.title: Low-Power, High-Gain, and High-Linearity SiGe BiCMOS Wide-Band Low-Noise Amplifier

dc_power.description: Total DC power dissipation of the amplifier

sky130_expected.calculation: P = VDD * I_total. With VDD=1.8V and typical bias currents of 10-15mA per stage.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Matches the paper's reported 54 mW dissipation at 1.8V supply.

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by the ratio of collector loads (R3, R4) to emitter degeneration (R1, R5) and feedback (R6).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Expected to closely match the paper's 14.5 dB target when properly biased.

sky130_expected.calculation: Limited by the fT of the NPN transistors and parasitic node capacitances.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Using generic NPN models with tf=5p yields an fT of ~30GHz, providing an amplifier bandwidth in the 10-20GHz range.

sky130_expected.calculation: Dominated by the base resistance of Q2 and thermal noise of R6 and R5.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Feedback LNAs typically exhibit higher NF than inductively degenerated LNAs, aligning with the 5 dB reported.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench for the Wideband LNA measuring DC power, AC gain, unity-gain bandwidth, and transient output swing.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Wideband LNA Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* Generic models for missing PDK specific NPN/Diodes
.model npn npn (bf=100 is=1e-15 tf=5p cje=50f cjc=50f)
.model diode d (is=1e-15 rs=10)

* DUT (with appended component values for simulation)
Q1 n6 n9 n3 npn
Q2 n9 n1 n10 npn
Q3 n4 n3 n8 npn
R1 n0 n8 5
R2 n2 n3 1k
R3 n7 n9 200
R4 n4 n5 100
R5 n0 n10 5
R6 n1 n3 300
D1 n7 n6 diode
C1 n0 n10 10p
C2 n7 0 10p
D2 n7 n5 diode
D3 n2 0 diode

* Bias and Supply
Vdd n7 0 1.8
Vss n0 0 0
Rbias n7 n2 2k

* RF Input
Vac in_ac 0 DC 0 AC 1
Rs in_ac n1_ac 50
Cin n1_ac n1 10p

* RF Output
Cout n4 out_ac 10p
Rl out_ac 0 50

.control
  * DC Operating Point
  op
  let power = -i(Vdd)*1.8
  print power

  * AC Analysis
  ac dec 20 10Meg 100Gig
  let gain_db = vdb(out_ac)
  meas ac max_gain max gain_db
  meas ac f0db when gain_db=0 fall=1

  * Transient Analysis
  tran 1p 5n
  meas tran vout_pp pp v(out_ac)
.endc
.end
